changelog:
- Upgraded Fokk AI Inference Pipeline: Replaced retired OpenRouter and Gemini 1.5 endpoints with fast verified failover models, reasoning-off mode, and multi-turn conversation memory so Ask AI gives sharp, tailored, non-repetitive answers.
- Premium Minimal UI Overhaul: Redesigned Fokk AI into a clean, obsidian-dark segmented interface (Summary, Ask AI, Truth & Bias) with refined typography and zero emojis.
- Eliminated Scroll Glitches: Removed mid-scroll tab-collapse layout thrashing, fixed bottom clipping with clipToPadding and system bar/IME insets, and disabled bottom-sheet drag interception during nested scrolling.
- Contextual Key Numbers Grid: Replaced naked cyan metric chips with a clean 2-column stat grid pairing each figure with its contextual label.
- Uncluttered Ask AI Responses: Removed score/verdict/source-count clutter before AI replies, added a welcome quick-starter view, and fixed focus-stealing streaming scroll.
- Source Quality & Extraction Fixes: Blocked spam/low-quality domains, fixed newspaper drop-cap spacing artifacts, fixed provenance false matches, and made Audio Brief (TTS) initialize and toggle Listen/Stop reliably.
